control.label: Folder on this computer
control.openHint: Let Chat read the files in one folder and propose changes. Nothing is written until you approve it.
control.closeWithPending: Close folder {name}. Changes waiting for your approval will be dropped.

diff.staleNow: This file has changed since the change was proposed. Approving it will not write anything.
diff.noTextChange: The text is the same. Only the line endings or the end of the file differ.
diff.truncated: Showing the first {max} lines of each side. The rest is not shown here, and approving still applies the whole change.

outcome.applied: Applied. Your folder now has this change.
outcome.stale: Not applied. The file changed after this was proposed, so nothing was written. Ask Chat for a fresh change.
outcome.failedDenied: Not applied. That file is protected or outside the folder you opened.
outcome.failedIo: Not applied. The file could not be written. Check that it is not open in another program or read-only.

error.folder_unavailable: Folders can only be opened in the desktop app, on your own computer.
error.folder_mount_ipc_only: Pick the folder from the desktop app's window. It cannot be opened from here.
error.folder_mount_refused: That folder cannot be opened. A whole drive, your whole home folder, system folders, and folders that hold keys or this app's own data are not allowed. Pick a different folder.
error.folder_not_mounted: No folder is open. Open a folder first.
error.network: Could not reach the app. Try again.
error.noPicker: This version of the app cannot open a folder picker. Update the app and try again.
error.generic: Something went wrong with the folder. Try again.
